add_modal.title: Add MCP Server
add_modal.name_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens (e.g. tool.terminal)

marketplace.uninstall_confirm: Uninstall {{name}}? This will remove the server and its files.
marketplace.rust_notice: This server requires the Rust toolchain (cargo). First build may take 5-10 minutes.
marketplace.seal_verified_tooltip: Magic Seal present — kernel will honor the declared trust level.
marketplace.seal_unverified_tooltip: No Magic Seal — kernel will force trust level to untrusted at runtime (MGP v0.6.3 §10 invariant 3).
marketplace.unlisted_hint: These are installed on this machine, but no entry in the catalog matches them — usually because the connector was retired or moved upstream. The catalog keeps no record of what an entry used to be called, so there is no way to tell you what replaces one of these. They keep running until you remove them.
marketplace.restricted: Published only to you, through your hub access token.

deviation.env_unresolved: An environment variable is not set.

list.note: Descriptions come from each server's manifest. Groups follow the capability kind. A state is written only when it deviates, at the start of the row.
list.updates_note: Updates are applied from the marketplace tab.

detail.origin_marketplace: Installed from the marketplace on {{when}}, version {{version}}
detail.launch_hint: The command and its arguments. A change applies from the next start.
detail.policy_sub: who may use this server's tools
detail.policy_hint: Needs permission: an agent can use only the tools allowed for it under Access. Anyone: every agent can use it unless explicitly denied.
detail.env_hint: Secrets such as API keys go here. Values are masked once saved and never reach the logs.
detail.no_tools: This server has not reported any tools.
detail.unsaved_note: Nothing takes effect until you save.

access.hint: Per agent: this server as a whole, and per-tool overrides. Default follows the server's default policy.
